title: RULERS: Locked Rubrics and Evidence-Anchored Scoring for Robust LLM Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the probability density estimates of predicted scores against human ground truth distributions to observe whether the model hedges its predictions towards the statistical mean.

Evaluating the evaluator model's scoring agreement with human judgments (using Quadratic Weighted Kappa) when the sequential order of the evaluation rubric criteria is inverted (Reversed variant) compared to the standard order.
